blocks.content: Self-hosted, real, existing infrastructure is a genuinely real, practical reason a team might choose Jenkins over a hosted platform like GitHub Actions.

8. A Real, Common Mistake
Credentials hard-coded directly in a real, committed Jenkinsfile is a real, common mistake, exactly the same real risk already covered for GitHub Actions.
This often happens during early, real, rushed setup, real credentials embedded directly to get something genuinely working quickly.
The honest fix is exactly the credentials binding already covered earlier in this topic, keeping real secrets entirely out of committed, version-controlled code.
This mistake is worth catching immediately in any real code review, exactly the same scrutiny already covered for secrets throughout this entire course.
